app.title: Guardians
app.tagline: Defend the ship against the northern hordes
menu.hint: 1 player · 35 levels · build a maze of towers
fx.percent_hp: Removes {0}% of current health (not on bosses)
fx.root: Holds the target in place (not on bosses)
msg.creep: A creep is in the way
msg.boss_warning: Boss! Do not let it through
help.tip: Tip: place towers anywhere as long as a path to the ship remains. Make the path as long as you can!
help.controls: Drag = move the map · pinch/scroll = zoom · drag a card out of the tray = build · hold a tower = move it · minimap: tap to jump
touch.hint: Drag the ghost or tap elsewhere, confirm with the check mark
hud.moving: Drag the tower to a new spot. It has to be set up again there ({0} s)
hud.drag_hint: Drag a card onto the map to build
msg.air_wave: Flyers! They ignore your maze and fly over towers. Only towers that hit air can bring them down
app.credits: 3D models: KayKit and Kenney (CC0), animals from the Everything Library by David OReilly (CC BY 4.0)
mode.classic.desc: Build a maze of towers in an open field. Co-op with more players, very hard solo.
mode.elements.desc: A fixed path with build plates. Six elements that strengthen or weaken each other, towers you mix. Made for playing alone.
menu.hint.classic: 1 player · 35 levels · build a maze of towers
menu.hint.elements: 1 player · 40 levels · fixed path, 6 elements, mixed towers
msg.locked_level: Not available yet: this comes later in the game
trait.healing.desc: Heals 20% of its neighbours when it dies
trait.undead.desc: Stands up once, 5 s after it died, with 33% life
trait.mechanical.desc: Invulnerable for 3 s of every 12 s
msg.boss_element: Guardian! Beating it gives you a new element
hud.elements_none: Learn more elements first to mix them
help.tip.classic: Tip: place towers anywhere as long as a path to the ship remains. Make the path as long as you can!
help.tip.elements: Tip: every element is strong against the next one in the circle (Light, Darkness, Water, Fire, Nature, Earth) and weak against the previous one. Check which element the next wave has!
msg.new_element: Guardian beaten! Choose a new element (+ in the tray)
mode.survivor.desc: One tower that cannot move. Buy weapons and upgrades in the shop and survive 15 minutes against endless hordes.
menu.hint.survivor: 1 player · 15 minutes · a shop with weapons and upgrades
help.tip.survivor: Tip: the shop refreshes every 45 s. Buy a second weapon first, then upgrades, and do not save up for too long. Duplicate weapons get stronger.
sv.free_slot: Weapon slots full: you can only upgrade a weapon you already have
sv.wagon: A gold bull! Catch it for extra gold
wk.projectile: Shoots the nearest enemy. Pierces {0} extra enemies
wk.orbit: {0} blade(s) circle the tower and hit everything in their way
wk.artillery: Lobs a bomb up to {0} tiles at an enemy: damage in a circle
wk.mine: Lays mines that explode when an enemy touches them (max. {0})
wk.glaive: A disc flies out and back and hits everything on the way
